title: Orthopaedic follow-up, Priya on speakerphone from Toronto, Hinglish
note: Fictional script for the leg-and-back story (data/synthetic/sunita). Replayed answers are the recorded expected extraction, not a model. The doctor tells the family to stop the second doctor's Diclofenac because of the NSAID allergy on the card; CareSaathi only records those words as a pending change for a named person to confirm.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Namaste Sunita ji, kaisi hain aap? Pair ka dard ab kaisa hai?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Thoda kam hai doctor, par raat ko peeth ka dard jaga deta hai.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Theek hai. Pregabalin 75 mg raat ko ek baar chalu rakhiye. Calpol 650 mg zaroorat par din mein teen baar tak.

segments.speaker: C
segments.text: Doctor, main Toronto se baat kar rahi hoon. Kya doosre doctor ki diclofenac wali goli bhi leni hai?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Nahi. Allergy card par NSAID likha hai, isliye diclofenac wali goli band kar dijiye.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Physiotherapy jaari rakhiye aur do hafte baad phir aaiye.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Agar peshab ya potty par control na rahe, ya dono pairon mein achanak kamzori ho, to turant emergency mein aaiye.
